verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a password manager, but the evidence pack shows no self-hostable deployment of the core 1Password vault or service. Connect Servers only expose 1Password items to your own apps through a private REST API. That is an adjacent integration component, not a self-hosted core product, so it earns no credit. Community comments lamenting the loss of local vault storage are consistent with this absence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
